8293.title: Temporary image loading investigation
8293.rootCauseOneLine: The external renderer is absent from trusted main; core file transport accepts temp images without a fixed /tmp allowlist.
8293.proposedFix: Obtain separately authorized renderer source and reproduce its actual path policy on isolated macOS before changing any file-access boundary.
8293.caveats: Two clean Linux checkouts verify only the core countercheck. The community renderer and actual macOS browser screenshot flow remain unverified. No safe simple-fix PR. Full check script and outputs are inline in the report.
